synthetic_window_scope: cost probe at supplied center; no source-to-entry trajectory
reset_scope: public reset invalidates event; reset-certificate comparison only, zero live gain

memory.scope: process peak RSS; no full-horizon memory guarantee

persistence.scope: snapshot/serialization/xz; checkpoint cost scaled to 400 beats; local write latency covered by safety allowance

estimate.method: 400 steps per role; 1.5x observed maximum step, 2x maximum oracle/evidence, 2x setup, 3x synthetic window, explicit checkpoint/restore allowance
estimate.scope: planning envelope from bounded early trajectories; not a confidence interval or endpoint proof

stop_conditions: 400 target beats per role without expected result: investigate, never force completion
rolling 8-step mean above 1.5 times sampled maximum: stop/re-estimate
remaining upper projection exceeds 30-minute combined campaign cap: stop/re-estimate
RSS above 1024 MiB or resource bit size above twice sampled maximum: stop/re-estimate
failed numerical/certificate/charge admission or changed graph/profile/policy: stop
